prompts.name: Claw Swipe
prompts.subject: A close-up orange feline paw emerging from a detailed pearl astronaut glove cuff, THREE tapered luminous cyan claw blades making one strong diagonal swipe from lower left toward upper right. Three beautiful curved blade-shaped energy cuts and fragments suggest a forceful SINGLE-target slash; claw blades have sharp tapered tips, not straight rods. Dramatic cyan light against violet-indigo nebula and fractured cosmic dust. The paw and white cuff remain clearly identifiable. No entire cat body.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE finished square mobile action-MOBA ability icon for Dimensions Front, Andromeda Timmy, an agile SMALL orange tabby CAT in a pearl-white astronaut suit with graphite joints, round glass helmet visor, emerald eyes, cyan claw tips, TWO small backpack thrusters. Primary request: replace cheap blocky icons with premium digital-painted science-fantasy game ability artwork, dimensional painted materials, strong broad silhouettes readable at 64px, dramatic controlled lighting, polished brushwork, crisp focal point and layered atmosphere. Square 1024x1024 artwork, fully opaque edge-to-edge illustrated background in rich dark indigo space, cyan/violet nebula haze and sparse stars, no empty gray or black cutout background. Composition inside the central 75% safe circle because game HUD clips to a circle; full-bleed art outside. Restrained cyan, pearl, indigo with warm orange/amber contrast; distinct subject occupies 60-70% of frame. No lettering, symbols resembling words, digits, borders, frame, UI controls, collage, logos or watermark. Exactly one icon, not a sheet. Avoid primitive stick claws, spherical mittens, flat vector glyphs, busy microdetail and photorealism.

Dramatic cyan light against violet-indigo nebula and fractured cosmic dust. The paw and white cuff remain clearly identifiable. No entire cat body.

prompts.name: Stardust
prompts.subject: A substantial swirling cyan and violet STARDUST MIST CLOUD spreading over a clearly visible curved planetary surface, warm amber star specks embedded in rolling cloud banks, cool luminous center and soft layered outer billows. One large identifiable star-shaped spark nestled in the center, not a collection of thin arbitrary runes. The mist forms a broad placed area, with a subtly glowing circular ground boundary. Rich space atmosphere fills the background. This is the magical mist ability, not a fire explosion, crystal orb or galaxy chart.

prompts.name: Jet Pounce
prompts.subject: The small orange tabby astronaut CAT in a dynamic side/back three-quarter LEAP toward the upper right, curled orange striped tail and round glass helmet, two pearl-white BACKPACK THRUSTERS emitting visible cyan jets with amber-hot cores and long curved motion trails toward the lower left. Show the small cat body and two-backpack jet action, NOT a lone boot. Broad clear airborne silhouette, kinetic diagonal framing, indigo starfield with streaked nebula gives a readable leap direction. No additional characters.

prompts.name: Scratch
prompts.subject: Ultimate attack: the small orange tabby astronaut CAT lunges toward a single dark enemy silhouette in the background, the foreground dominated by THREE large tapered cyan CLAW BLADES and THREE parallel curved slash trails flying toward that ONE silhouette. Warm amber target-capture glow forms a partial ring around the one distant enemy. Cat's glass helmet and aggressive pose visible but secondary to the three striking claws. A powerful amber-and-cyan burst illuminates deep violet cosmic haze. No gore, no extra targets, no flat crosshair diagram.

prompts.name: Claw
prompts.subject: Basic melee attack: a close-up orange TABBY CAT PAW, with clearly feline fur, three visible small curved CYAN CLAW TIPS, extending from a pearl-white padded astronaut cuff. A controlled short forward striking pose; NO giant diagonal slash trails and NO full cat body. Dark indigo/cobalt space background with warm orange dust particles and soft cyan reflected light, beautifully shaded fur and armor. Distinct calm compact silhouette differentiates the short basic strike from the powerful Claw Swipe skill.
